text:
ania: Quick flag from the Next Starter (llamachain) sample: on hybrid pages we're seeing duplicate POST /v1/embeddings and double auth refreshes during initial load.
dave: Can you share repro steps?
ania: Clone starter, npm i, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, open /demo. On first load two identical embed calls and logs show two refresh attempts.
kris: Likely SSR + client both running pipeline; JS SDK currently doesn't coalesce identical embedding requests. Python had that behavior.
ania: Short-term I added a tiny inflight dedupe in lib/embed.ts (Map key=JSON.stringify(input)) which suppresses the duplicate calls. Patch in repo.
dave: Also lowered SDK retry.maxAttempts in the sample to avoid repeated refresh attempts.
morgan: I'll file an SDK issue for parity: request coalescing for embeddings + single-inflight auth refresh (mutex) so samples can remove hacks. sdk-bot: Created SDK-901 - js-sdk: embedding coalescing + auth refresh mutex (https://tracker.redwood.ai/SDK-901).
kris: Please add a Playwright test in the sample that asserts exactly one POST /v1/embeddings on initial load so we catch regressions.
ania: Added test PR and README note about hybrid patterns (server-only vs client-only vs hybrid with dedupe). Will revert sample hack once SDK fix lands. Thanks all.
